Hi all — triage notes from the onboarding ops side.

Likely causes: duplicate supplier profile (previous claim with a different email), or the invite token is bound to angela@deltatech.com while your procurement alias is onboarding@deltatech.com. We need two things to move forward:
1) The invite token (the long string at the end of the invite URL).
2) A short audit snippet — please try to reproduce the flow and capture the timestamp of the failure (we only need the time and timezone).

What I'll do from our side: check pending claim table, look for supplier_name = "DeltaTech", and inspect claim_history for any prior accepted claims. If there's a prior accepted claim with a different email, we can either merge the accounts or reassign the claim to the procurement mailbox.

Hi Angela — we found the issue and pushed a fix.

Summary of what happened: an older, incomplete supplier record for DeltaTech had been created months ago and was bound to angela@deltatech.com. Because the invite token matched that prior record, the portal refused the claim from the procurement alias. We verified the timing you provided and located the prior claim (created 2026-11-12).

Actions taken:
- Merged the duplicate supplier profiles and remapped the active invite token (X4f9-9gd2-claimtoken-7ab) to allow claims for onboarding@deltatech.com.
- Cleared stale claim entries for the DeltaTech tenant.
- Re-issued a fresh claim link, sent to onboarding@deltatech.com with a one-time token valid for 24 hours. You should receive an email titled: "Redwood — Claim your supplier profile (DeltaTech)" shortly.

Please try the new link and confirm when you can access the portal. If you still hit a barrier, reply and we'll open a live session (I can loop in engineering).

Internal note to Soojin/Ben: please add a short post-mortem to the onboarding backlog — this pattern (invite sent to personal alias while procurement uses shared mailbox) has caused 3 similar incidents this quarter. Suggested mitigations: show both recipient addresses in the claim email and offer a "claim to alternate email" flow.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Supplier Success
